title: Clinical-looking measurement stays opaque evidence
purpose: Demonstrate that optional medical-source evidence does not introduce diagnostic or treatment semantics into L2.

expected.semantic_interpretation: A clinical-looking source item can be carried as opaque evidence without interpreting medical meaning.
expected.observability: The repository exposed the source item.
expected.opportunity: No opportunity claim is required for this fixture.
expected.time: Phenomenon, observation/result, and ingestion times remain distinct fields.
expected.provenance: Health repository/provider provenance remains explicit and optional.
expected.raw_derived: Evidence kind is explicit and does not imply a pattern.
expected.lineage: No correction, deletion, or supersession is asserted.
expected.must_not_infer: Do not infer diagnosis, treatment, risk, medical advice, or a personal pattern from this item.
